source_review.notes: Checked the official ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022 and 15288:2023 records, The Open Group TOGAF Architecture Development Method and Architecture Content, the SEI Quality Attribute Workshop and Views and Beyond collections, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 and Privacy Framework. Six destinations returned HTTP 200; both official ISO records were retrievable through source review but rejected the command-line client with HTTP 403. Claims are limited to each source's stated scope.
